adjudication.rationale: In `parseRefreshTokenResponse` the code does `schema.safeParse(...)` and then immediately `throw new Error(...)` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, but still returns the `SafeParseReturn` object. As a result, any downstream `if (!tokenResponse.success)` checks are effectively unreachable (e.g. `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` and `salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` now check `.success` after calling `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, but failures would have already thrown). This makes the error-handling contract ambiguous/misleading, though it’s not necessarily a functional defect by itself.
